svg.title: Mockup 10: copy from the last event (event admin)
svg.text: 10 · Copy from the last event: from, dates, parts, run; then a result per part (event admin)
One page, four steps (L7). Admin runs the copy as a job on the server (U13): the tab can close, each part is all or nothing, a failed part can be retried.
Use case: an event admin of both events starts the new draft from the last event, leaving out the theme, and fixes the one part that failed
A · The page at 1280 px, before running
Only once, while this event is a draft. You are an event admin of both events.
Events of Demo LAN you admin
Fri 20 Nov → Fri 12 Mar: the new event's start less the last's (U14)
each on by default; leave out what this event does new (U12)
Items, kinds and quiet hours, at the new dates
Zones, layouts, playlists, schedules; never the devices
The published theme and its files
Every part's settings and alert settings, not the webhook
Moves the server and bot here once Demo Event is archived
You can close this page: the copy runs on the server and Health shows it.
B · Running: one line per part
C · Done, one part failed: retry it alone

g.text: The copy would pass the event's 2 GiB
storage quota. Free space, or ask the
superadmin to raise it, then retry.
The theme was left out: Theme studio starts empty.

svg.text: Parts come from the modules' declared
clone parts (D14); each says what it copies
and, after the copy, how much. Devices,
members, the join code, the audit and the
venue IP check are never copied
Each part is all or nothing: a part over the
quota copies nothing and the others
stand. Retry runs that part again; a part
Discord's move waits for the last event to
be archived, so a live event never loses its
